entities.summary: Manuel Ignacio de Vivanco Iturralde was a Peruvian politician and military leader who served as the de facto President of Peru from 1843 to 1844. He was born in Lima, Peru. He led part of the Peruvian forces in the campaign against the reunification of Peru-Bolivian Confederacy.
